comparator.name: Communication and Information Studies
comparator.sourceNotes: Adopted 2026–2027 OER Article 9.1 and the exact annual course list require a pass in Discourse Analysis before Discourse and Social Interaction. The first course is in the English Language and Media route but is absent from the Dutch Media and Journalism allocation. The published Formuleren course overlaps in discourse methods, but its explicit use as an entry requirement is for Interactie in Organisaties. Article 3.7 allows an individual examination-board exemption, not a cohort rule. The provisional 2027–2028 recruitment list omits Discourse and Social Interaction and lists Digital Deception and Redactionele innovaties, without an adopted replacement, credits or cohort bridge. The shown allocation has 60 EC each year, including 30 EC open study and a 12 EC thesis and colloquium pair. OER 9.1 requires passing all first- and second-year courses for the thesis and colloquium. The Dutch diagnostic and any required remediation gate Academic Skills, and 42 EC plus the designated skills and language conditions apply to ordinary first-year study advice. Orientation and language requirements add no credits. Open study has approval and level rules. Workshops and practicals normally require 80% attendance.

routeSelection.basis: The registry target is Dutch-taught, and the adopted 2026–27 OER names Media en Journalistiek as the only current Dutch-taught specialization. The two English routes and closed teach-out routes do not match this target; the selection follows formal target identity, not UCR fit.

audience.programmeDescription: VU Communication and Information Studies examines language, media and communication. Its Media and Journalism route combines media analysis, rhetoric, journalism practice, research methods and an individual thesis.
audience.comparisonExplanation: VU’s published course allocation totals 180 EC. One required course has a prerequisite outside the route table. The curriculum below shows the published allocation while the applicable progression rule is being confirmed.

curriculum.limitation: The allocation includes 30 EC of open study. Discourse and Social Interaction requires a pass in Discourse Analysis, which is absent from the route table. VU’s provisional 2027–2028 list shows a revised second year. The approved requirements for this cohort still need confirmation. The thesis and colloquium require completion of years one and two. Orientation and the language test carry no credit.

componentNotes.y3-01: Open 30 EC: an approved minor, approved free choices with at least 12 EC at advanced level, or a permitted internship and courses.
componentNotes.y2-03: The current entry requirement is a pass in Discourse Analysis. The route table does not list that prerequisite.
componentNotes.y3-05: A 3 EC parallel colloquium: organize a symposium, present thesis research and write a public-facing science piece. All components must pass.
componentNotes.y3-06: A 9 EC individual research thesis within a supervised theme group. Mandatory meetings, an approved work plan and a progress decision apply; supervisor and second reader assess independently.
